description: Waste collected per month is a dataset listed in City of Melbourne open data portal (data.melbourne.vic.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by data.melbourne.vic.gov.au. The City of Melbourne provides a number of waste collection services. The dataset details the weight (in tonnes) of waste collected in a number of different categories including residential garbage, hard waste, commingled recycling, cardboard, green waste, litter and dumped rubbish. Coverage: City of Melbourne, Australia. The portal files it under the publisher data.melbourne.vic.gov.au. Its tags are bins, dumped rubbish, green waste, hard waste, recycling. It offers 3 resource(s) in csv, json. The portal shows 2022-12-14 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-melbourne-vic-gov-au-portal.
